scenes.title: QA that runs the store — not a doc dump.
scenes.body: One Story → merge requests reviewed → checklist proven → browser agent executes → defects gated → learnings stick → ship call with a price tag.

scenes.title: Spreadsheets don’t click Buy.
scenes.body: GenAI alone invents ZIPs. TMS never reads the diff. One bot can’t batch, explore, and script PDP. Nobody knows what the run cost.

cards.p: Reads fine. Dies on the real cart total.
No merge findings → no failure tests.
No plain-English run, no risk plan, no $0 PDP script.
No AI ship / no-ship · no $ per op.

scenes.title: AI + CUA on one rail.
scenes.body: Generate and review overlap. Gate proves coverage. Three CUA surfaces plus Playwright BVA. Learning feeds the next prompt. Cost on every call.

scenes.title: Ticket before code. Every row proven.
scenes.body: Full coverage fills gaps. Review bugs become checklist items. Validated learnings ride the prompt — so the next run is smarter.

journey.title: Plain English → live browser.
journey.voice: Tester types intent — agent opens cart, toggles wrap, reads the total. No test author syntax. That’s AI + CUA in one breath.

journey.title: Defect card — you decide.
journey.voice: Nothing auto-files. F1 from review + CUA FAIL + exploratory align — you choose File defect, test problem, or skip.

bug.summary: Wrap API error still shows success toast; subtotal does not include $8 wrap fee
repro: Observe green toast but subtotal unchanged

journey.title: Fix once — next prompts remember.
journey.voice: Edit a step, reject a CUA call — becomes a rule on Generate, review, and CUA. Repeat mistakes get measured.
rules: Cart/checkout cases state guest vs signed-in and what is in the bag
Never assert subtotal without naming the visible line items
Refresh-after-toggle wrap must match fee on screen
journey.note: Next SHOP-like Story inherits these — no re-paste from wiki

journey.title: KB answer — cited.
journey.voice: Side path while you wait: ask how wrap pricing works. Router picks packs; answer cites behavior notes — same cost line as other AI ops.
journey.question: When gift wrap is toggled, where does the $8 fee hit the cart total?
journey.answer: Wrap is a cart line modifier on the SKU, not shipping. Subtotal recalculates before tax; checkout summary shows a ribbon icon per wrapped line. EU uses locale key gift.wrap.fee.

journey.title: AI verdict: don’t ship mobile yet.
journey.voice: New wrap hero image on cart drawer hurt LCP. Numbers alone are meh — the AI ship/no-ship call is the exec wow.

ai.headline: Mobile cart not ready — wrap hero competes with LCP
bullets: LCP 3.6s — large ribbon hero loads before cart lines
CLS good — not a layout bug
Fix: defer wrap marketing image · target LCP ≤ 2.5s · re-run

journey.title: Whole loop: $7.18.
journey.voice: Every AI job shows USD — generate, review, CUA, KB, PSI. BVA and cache hits are $0. Budget-friendly wow next to one consultant day.
